definitions.explanation: The assignment of actors to roles in a play, film, or other performance. Also refers to the resulting list of actors and their roles.

examples.japanese: {配役|はいやく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まった→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。
⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{配役|はいやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。

⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{配役|はいやく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ぴったり→ぴったり：02362_pittari⟧で、⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{演技|えんぎ}→演技：01890_engi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{素晴|すば}らしかった→素晴らしい：01119_subarashii⟧。
examples.english: The casting in this film was perfect, and every actor's performance was wonderful.

notes:
USAGE:
{配役|はいやく} can refer to both the process of casting (assigning roles) and the result (the cast list). In modern usage, the loanword キャスティング (casting) is also common for the process, while {配役|はいやく} is preferred in more formal or traditional contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {配役|はいやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧ (to decide the casting)
- {配役|はいやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}する→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧ (to announce the cast)
- {配役|はいやく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豪華|ごうか}→豪華：02815_gouka⟧だ (the cast is star-studded)
- ⟦{主役|しゅやく}→主役：04199_shuyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{配役|はいやく} (casting of the lead role)
